newsitem.title: USA: Sonus to get $3 mln payment from Daiichi.
newsitem.headline: Sonus to get $3 mln payment from Daiichi.

text.p: Sonus Pharmaceuticals Inc said on Wednesday that Japan's Daiichi Pharmaceutical Co Ltd would make a $3 million milestone payment to it for successfully completing a clinical trial of Sonus' EchoGen Emulsion.
The company said in a statement that the test involved a U.S. Phase 2 myocardial perfusion clinical trial. It was conducted at two clinical sites and included 60 patients.

EchoGen is a fluorocarbon-based ultrasound contrast agent. It has been investigated for efficacy and safety in clinical trials in more than 800 patients in a broad range of applications in both cardiology and radiology.
Daiichi has licensed EchoGen for Japan and nine other countries in the Pacific Rim and has agreed to pay a 30 percent royalty on net sales of EchoGen following approval.
"The ability to detect myocardial perfusion should prove useful in the real-time evaluation of coronary artery disease with echocardiography," the statement said.
